 Jalen Brunson’s ‘Law & Order SVU’ role revealed as trailer drops 
 By 
 Jenna Lemoncelli 
 Published 
 Oct. 30, 2026, 10:59 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make New York Post a Preferred Source 
 Jalen Brunson, NBA champ and, officially, actor.
 The Knicks guard plays a detective in a new “Law & Order SVU” trailer that released on Friday. 
 Brunson appears opposite the show’s megastar, Mariska Hargitay, who plays Captain Olivia Benson in the long-running NBC police drama. 
 4 
 Mariska Hargitay, left, and Stephanie March take a break from filming scenes on the set of “Law and Order: SVU” in New York, Tuesday, October 27, 2026. Jose Perez / BACKGRID 
 The pair are close friends and the actress is a diehard Knicks fan, as well as a staple on Celebrity Row at Madison Square Garden. 
 “Detective Madison,” Benson says in the trailer. 
 Explore More 
 A familiar problem is threatening to derail Knicks star’s hot start 
 Knicks vs. 76ers prediction: Jalen Brunson & Co. extend streak in Philly 
 Where to watch tonight’s Knicks vs. 76ers game for free: Time, livestream 
 “Hey captain,” Madison, portrayed by Brunson, wearing a detective badge around his neck responds with a smile.
 Episode 5 of Season 28 centers around an assault of a wedding guest at the reception. 
 “Benson and the squad uncover a secret that changes the course of the investigation; [DA Sonny] Carisi’s pursuit of justice becomes increasingly complicated when key witnesses refuse to cooperate,” the episode description reads. 
 4 
 Jalen Brunson of the New York Knicks celebrates a three-point basket against the Chicago Bulls in Chicago on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. Getty Images 
 4 
 New York Knicks’ Jalen Brunson speaks with Mariska Hargitay at the Roommates Show Block Party live podcast, Thursday, September 24, 2026, in New York. Corey Sipkin for the NY POST 
 Both Brunson and Hargitay teased his cameo on multiple occasions after the Knicks beat the Spurs in the NBA Finals to secure their first championship in 53 years. 
 Margitay first revealed their plan to have Brunson on “Law & Order SVU” during an appearance on the “Today Show” in August. 
 The Emmy-winning actress was a guest star on the “Roommates Show” live show — the weekly podcast hosted by Brunson and Knicks teammate Josh Hart — when the Knicks stars took the show experience to Randall’s Island Park in New York in September.
 4 
 New York Knicks guard Jalen Brunson, center, rides a parade float with Mariska Hargitay and his father Rick in New York on Thursday, June 18, 2026. Charles Wenzelberg/NY Post 
 Hargitay was also on the Knicks’ championship bus during their victory parade in New York on June 18. 
 The “Law & Order SVU” episode with Brunson, entitled “Forsaken,” with Brunson will air on Nov. 5 at 9 p.m. on NBC and streaming on Peacock.
